assumptions.input: fixed synthetic attitude_deg trace from gnc_dual_period
assumptions.legacy_physical_model_parameters: not used in this controller-only comparison
assumptions.legacy_schedule: physics_engine_2d calls PID every 10 ms in its 1 ms integration loop; 50 ms is an audit-only resampling
assumptions.physical_model_difference: not evaluated; no mass, inertia, thrust, friction, linkage, or actuator parameters are supplied
assumptions.production_schedule: one production PID compute per supplied sample; 10 ms and 50 ms are offline schedules
assumptions.servo_mapping: 90 + int(output), constrained to [0,180]; no physical write
assumptions.units: attitude and PID output are degrees; dt is seconds
